cards.verse_text: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;

cards.card_text: Then Paul gets personal: flee from youthful passions.
cards.verse_text: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

cards.card_text: They captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions.

cards.card_text: Ungodliness and worldly passions Hard work and careful planning Old friends and family ties
cards.verse_text: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,

cards.card_text: James points to the passions at war within them as the source of their conflicts and quarrels.
cards.verse_text: Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
cards.snippet: Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?

cards.card_text: Then Peter calls them obedient children and brings up the passions of their former ignorance.
cards.verse_text: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.

cards.card_text: Peter tells these obedient children to keep shaping their lives around the passions of their former ignorance.

cards.card_text: Peter says someone who's done with sin doesn't live out his remaining time on earth for human passions anymore.
cards.verse_text: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
cards.snippet: …he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.

cards.card_text: With lofty but empty words, the false teachers appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh.
cards.verse_text: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.
cards.snippet: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others…
